text.tspan: One Meaningful Game is an open-source project.
You can start building your own R36H console here:
It all started with a memory.
Over lunch, the lady told me about a game
from her childhood she could no longer name.
One forgotten game became an idea.
A weird idea that became four consoles.
Turn it off, turn it on.
You get to play along the way.
Switch it off and on again.
living in the past. It is about
A new idea. A new place.
changes how we see the world.
we didn't know we were looking for.
If the purpose is the journey,
there's no reason not to enjoy it.
being perfect. It is about learning,
Because the only way to win a run
is one step after another one.
